tiers.formalized: machine-checked proof of the claim (Lean-class); no artifact holds this tier yet
tiers.oracle-tested: numbers produced under an enforced oracle gate (bitwise/fixed-point/monotonicity) — a failing gate would have blocked the artifact
tiers.measured: honest measurement without an oracle gate (probe runs, AUROC tables, wall-clock benchmarks)
tiers.unverified: plans, drafts, or numbers not yet reproduced

swe_agent_rl_2026-10-16.json.basis: Roadmap AC2 (v5.63): toy macro-action agent on the mini SWE sandbox; light SFT warm start (15 behaviour-cloning steps on scripted demos from the 10 train tasks) then rejection-sampling fine-tuning with a verified-DONE reward (success only when DONE directly follows a passing TEST and the visible + hidden verifier passes); greedy pass rate over 3 shuffled candidate orders on train and 10 held-out tasks; single seed; T100 checks after > after_sft and the hash

q1_short_conv_2026-10-16.json.basis: Roadmap Q1 (v5.63): KDA:MLA hybrid (MLA at layers 0, 2, 5) with vs without the GDA causal short conv on the B2 key-value recall task, 1000 steps, separate train/eval streams, single seed; no benefit at this scale (0.420 vs 0.426); T101 checks layouts, hash and above-chance accuracy

mtp_light_ab_2026-10-16.json.basis: Roadmap B2-5 (v5.67): fresh default vs MiMo-style light MTP heads trained with the MTP loss on the frozen toy_v5.13 main model (same batches, steps and seed, window 16 for light); greedy speculative decoding must be token-identical to plain greedy (gate) for both; acceptance, tokens per round and head size; head-step latency is CPU telemetry outside the hash; single seed; T105 re-checks gate and hash

nope_temperature_ab_2026-10-16.json.basis: Roadmap U3 (v5.69): one all-NoPE MLA model trained on key-value recall at length 64 with floor_scale 64 (temperature exactly 1 during training), evaluated on the same weights with the Llama 4 NoPE temperature off / 0.1 / 0.3 at 1x, 2x, 4x the training length; separate train/eval streams; single seed; T107 checks that accuracy at the training length is identical for every temperature, and the hash

mtp_acceptance_2026-10-16.json.basis: Roadmap Q5 (v5.63): greedy MTP speculative decoding vs plain greedy on 8 prompts; the greedy-equivalence gate (token-identical output) must hold or the script writes nothing; acceptance from the committed toy_v5.13 checkpoint, the untrained qwen_next lite model only exercises rollback with GDA + short-conv state; wall-clock excluded from the hash; T101 re-checks gate and hash

mimo_hybrid_2026-10-15.json.basis: Phase B2 v5.62 trained key-value recall (MQAR-style, 6 layers, window 8, query distance >= 64): dense vs all-SWA vs MiMo 5:1 hybrid vs hybrid + learnable sink, 2000 steps, separate train/eval streams; all-SWA is the structural negative control (stays at chance); T96 checks the artifact's structure and attendable-key accounting

csa_learned_r3_2026-10-15.json.basis: Phase B v5.61 learned-compressor round 3 (4x only, hidden 64, 9600 steps) on the csa_ab probe; settings chosen on the separate validation stream at L=128 and L=512 (relu2 and 16x-at-9600 recorded as negative there); stores trained weights and the oracle ceiling; T95 re-evaluates a slice
